items.title: A study of Tapinarof cream for Atopic Dermatitis is paused
items.summary: Organon and Co leads this final-stage test (phase 3). The study team’s reason: “As a precaution, study drug dosing is paused due to a PK finding in OG505-3104. No safety signal or change to the established safety or benefit-risk profile has been identified. The Sponsor is further investigating and assessing the data”. It may start again. The registry doesn’t say when it was paused. The date above is when its record was last updated.

items.title: A study of INZ-701 for Ectonucleotide Pyrophosphatase/Phosphodiesterase1 Deficiency was stopped early
items.summary: Inozyme Pharma ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 27 people. The study team’s reason: “The study was terminated by the sponsor prior to planned completion based on a review of the data across indications and overall program considerations. Study termination was not related to participant safety”. The registry lists its end date as 19 Aug 2026.

items.title: A study of Poziotinib for NSCLC is paused
items.summary: Spectrum Pharmaceuticals, Inc leads this final-stage test (phase 3). The study team’s reason: “The study has not enrolled any patients. The study design is under discussion and will likely be redesigned in consultation with the FDA”. It may start again. The registry doesn’t say when it was paused. The date above is when its record was last updated.

items.title: A study of INZ-701 for Ectonucleotide Pyrophosphatase/phosphodiesterase1 Deficiency was stopped early
items.summary: Inozyme Pharma ran this final-stage test (phase 3) with 2 people. The registry lists its end date as 31 Aug 2026.
